name: tpu-v2
description: Extended tiny-tpu inference datapath targeted by this toolchain. The RTL in src/ does NOT implement this yet; this file is the requirements contract the RTL must satisfy, and the emulator in sw/ is the bit-exact reference it must match.

datapath.note: act_min is -127 not -128 so that symmetric negation never overflows and so weights and activations share one saturation rule.
datapath.wide_note: Selected tensors are carried at int16: attention logits always, and optionally the transformer residual stream, where a ViT's outlier channels otherwise set the scale for every ordinary value. Widening costs unified-buffer entries and vector-unit width, not array width -- no wide tensor is ever fed to the systolic array, because 32767 * 127 * 576 overflows the int32 accumulator.

requant.shift_note: shift = 31 - frexp_exponent(M). A real multiplier at or above 0.5 needs a shift below 31, so the lower bound is 0, not 31.
requant.note: One 32x32->64 multiply and an arithmetic shift per output element. Per-channel requires a (multiplier, shift) RAM addressed by output column -- 5 bytes per column, so 16 entries for a 16-wide array. Measured to be worth it: per-tensor weight scales are the dominant int8 error source in a ViT.

unified_buffer.note: Working window only. Weights live in DRAM and are streamed; the UB holds the active tile plus one prefetched tile.

dram.note: Nexys Video / equivalent DDR3. 512 MB comfortably holds the 24.8 M int8 weights of DA-V2-Small.

softmax.note: Two cascaded 256-entry ROMs and one multiply give exp() over the full int16 logit range: exp(-s*(256*hi + lo)) = exp(-s*256*hi) * exp(-s*lo). Attention logits must arrive at int16; requantizing them to int8 makes the exponential too granular and corrupts every probability in the row.
